nodes.title: Identifying Emotional States using Keystroke Dynamics
nodes.dataset: Keystroke data from participants performing daily tasks, labeled with self-reported emotional states via experience-sampling questionnaires.
nodes.methodology: A field study collected keystroke data and self-reported emotional states. Keystroke features (key duration, latency) were extracted and used to train decision-tree classifiers for 15 emotional states.
nodes.contribution: Proposed keystroke dynamics as a non-intrusive, cost-effective method for emotion detection, demonstrating its viability in real-world HCI applications.

nodes.title: Behavioral Biometrics in Assisted Living: A Methodology for Emotion Recognition
nodes.methodology: Combines computational geometry, image processing, graph theory for region detection, and neural networks for classification. Leverages Paul Ekman's facial expression theory and integrates with service-oriented architectures for real-time monitoring.
nodes.contribution: Proposes a novel methodology for emotion recognition using facial expressions, combining biometric traits with risk-assessment frameworks for smart monitoring in neurodegenerative disease management.

nodes.title: Emotion Recognition through Keystroke Dynamics on Touchscreen Keyboards
nodes.dataset: Study involving 152 test persons with varying time limits (no time limit, 5 minutes, 3.5 minutes) and demographic data (age, gender, education).
nodes.methodology: Developed an Android app and keyboard layout to record keystroke dynamics. Hypotheses derived from Yerkes-Dodson-Law and Flow theory. Conducted a study with 152 participants, analyzing data via SPSS to validate correlations between keystroke metrics and emotional states.
nodes.contribution: First application of keystroke dynamics on touchscreen keyboards for emotion recognition, integrating biometric data (pressure, size) and psychological theories (Yerkes-Dodson-Law, Flow theory).

nodes.title: A Review of Emotion Recognition Methods Based on Keystroke Dynamics and Mouse Movements
nodes.dataset: Various studies with participants performing tasks (e.g., online shopping, typing exercises) to collect physiological and behavioral data under different emotional states.
nodes.methodology: Analyzing keystroke dynamics and mouse movements as biometric features, including data collection, feature extraction, and classifier training for emotion detection.
nodes.contribution: Comprehensive review of emotion recognition methods using input devices, highlighting multimodal approaches and real-world applications.

nodes.title: Human Micro-Expression: A Novel Social Behavioral Biometric for Person Identification
nodes.dataset: Proprietary benchmark dataset with 250 Twitter users' microblog samples.
nodes.methodology: An emotion detection model extracts emotion probability scores from microblogs. Emotion-progression features are generated using dynamic time warping. Rank-level weighted majority voting fusion improves identification accuracy.
nodes.contribution: Introduces human micro-expression as a novel SBB trait. Develops emotion detection and progression feature extraction techniques for person identification.
